subject: Asking for density output from gdistsamp, but abundance is returned

messages.author: 496dc58cd6adfd32
messages.subject: Asking for density output from gdistsamp, but abundance is returned
parts:
Hi all,

Apologies if I'm just missing something obvious here, but I haven't been able to find my answer in old posts, so thanks in advance for any help. I'm looking at variables affecting bobwhite density in central Nebraska. I visited 48 points twice each. I'm using gdistsamp models.

The problem is that while I put "density" in for the model output argument, the model produces only abundance estimates (as do all my other models, and predict(), and coef() will not return density estimates when I ask for "state" estimates, only abundance estimates when I ask for "lambda".) Here is my umf and an example model that I'm running: 

library(unmarked)
umf<-with(nobo_bin,{
  unmarkedFrameGDS(y=cbind(D50,D100,D150,D200,D250,D300),
                   siteCovs=data.frame(site_id, crp_type, habitat_type,
                                       habitat_size, field_size, weighted_hits_cv,
                                       forb_hits_cv, grass_hits_avg,
                                       forb_hits_avg, floral_species_richness,
                                       dens_woody_edge, dens_woody_int, bare_grd_avg),
                   yearlySiteCovs = data.frame(julian_date, jd_sq, time, temp),
                   dist.breaks=c(0,50,100,150,200,250,300),
                   survey="point",
                   unitsIn="m",
                   numPrimary=2)
})

#Half normal key function with polynomial mixture:
HN_Null_P<-gdistsamp(~1,~1,~1,keyfun="halfnorm",mixture="P", unitsOut="ha", 
                     output="density",data=umf)

Here's the output:
summary(HN_Null_P)
Call:
gdistsamp(lambdaformula = ~1, phiformula = ~1, pformula = ~1, 
    data = umf, keyfun = "hazard", output = "density", unitsOut = "ha", 
    mixture = "P")

Thanks again for any help!
-Conor
